headlines.title: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Fell In The AI Optics Selloff, Is It Still Undervalued?
headlines.summary: Lumentum stock reaction to AI optics selloff and earnings setup Lumentum Holdings (LITE) has been in focus after the stock fell 16% over the past week during a broad selloff in AI optics names following a hotter September inflation report. The move comes just ahead of Lumentum's November 4 fiscal first quarter update. Management has already guided revenue above the prior quarter and highlighted strong demand for AI optical components through early 2029.

headlines.title: Optics Stocks Tumble as Tech Selloff Deepens Ahead of Earnings: Coherent Tumbles 12%, Applied Optoelectronics Drops 10%, Lumentum Falls 9%
headlines.summary: The AI optics trade powered some of the market's biggest gains this year, but a chipmaker-led selloff is now hitting Coherent, Lumentum, and Applied Optoelectronics all at once, right before each company steps up to report earnings.

headlines.title: Coherent Just Dropped 19% in a Week, Lumentum 16%. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares fell 19% in the past week and Lumentum fell 16%, as AI optics stocks sold off after a hot September inflation report. Coherent put out no news except its earnings date, and analysts’ revenue estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 held up through the selloff.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
